description: Map every scanner's native severity onto a normalized ERROR/WARNING/INFO contract so downstream gating (the ecosystem-manager R1 gate) is consistent across tools.

requirements.title: Severity normalization mapping
requirements.description: Each scanner runner must map critical/high native severities to ERROR, medium/moderate to WARNING, and low/info to INFO. ERROR is the only level that gates R1. The mapping is the load-bearing contract and must be unit-covered per scanner output shape.

validation.notes: gosec HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW map to ERROR/WARNING/INFO respectively.
osv-scanner CRITICAL/HIGH map to ERROR; MODERATE maps to WARNING.
gitleaks findings normalize to ERROR (secret exposure is always error-class).
pnpm audit critical/high map to ERROR; moderate to WARNING; low to INFO.
